aboveContentComponents.description: Optional array of components to render above the main content; allows for things like tags, badges, etc

aspectRatio.description: Crop image to the given aspect ratio by default

backgroundColor.description: The single background colour of the component.

bodyText.description: Text content of the card; will be put into a paragraph; expects plain text / simple inline HTML

cardAsLink.description: Whether to render the entire card as a link (if a link is provided); otherwise a button will be used

colorTheme.description: Colour keyword for theming purposes. May be used for headings, buttons, accents, and other UI elements according to the component implementation.

context.description: The kebab-case or BEM element chain name of the parent component or variant (if contextually relevant). Note: For components that use the BEM trait, this must be set before init_bem_classes() is called for class naming to work as expected.

focalPoint.description: The focal point of the image to use when cropping - x and y values between 0 and 100

heading.description: Heading text of the card; will be put into an H3 by default; expects plain text / simple inline HTML

isNested.description: Whether this component is nested inside another element; used for simplifying layout and HTML structure handling

offset.description: The percentage offsets of the image to use when cropping

orientation.description: Orientation of the component content, if applicable

originalImageOrientation.description: The original orientation of the image; can be used as a data attribute to tweak CSS for cropping

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set. If explicitly set, handling is component-specific depending on CSS requirements: some will use it in place of generic defaults, others will add a wrapper or adjust BEM classes but otherwise keep the same HTML structure.

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests

innerComponents.description: Inner components to be rendered within this component
